chapter.title: The Signal Room
chapter.author_label: Synthetic showcase fixture — not product authorship
prose: At dusk, the room kept one small promise: the signal would return.
A quiet page became a threshold when the first light moved across the line.
The scene gathered around the sentence, then softened when the reader asked it to.
